topics.name: Atomic Structure and the Periodic Table

specification_points.description: Describe the relative charges and masses of protons, neutrons, and electrons
Define atomic number, mass number, and isotopes
Describe the arrangement of electrons in shells, sub-shells, and orbitals
Write electron configurations using s, p, d notation
Explain trends in atomic radius, ionisation energy, and electronegativity across periods and down groups
Explain successive ionisation energies and their relationship to electronic structure
Describe properties and reactions of elements in Groups 1, 2, and 7
Describe ionic bonding and the formation of ionic compounds
Describe covalent bonding (including co-ordinate/dative covalent bonds)
Describe metallic bonding and its relationship to physical properties
Predict the shape of molecules using VSEPR theory
Describe van der Waals forces, permanent dipole-dipole forces, and hydrogen bonding
Explain the anomalous properties of water in terms of hydrogen bonding
Explain trends in boiling points of molecules in terms of intermolecular forces
Use the concept of the mole and Avogadro's constant
Calculate molar masses; convert between mass, moles, and number of particles
Calculate amounts using the ideal gas equation pV = nRT
Perform reacting quantities calculations using balanced equations
Calculate percentage yield and atom economy
Define standard enthalpy changes: formation, combustion, neutralisation
Apply Hess's law and use energy cycles (Born-Haber at A2 level)
Use bond enthalpies to estimate ΔH for reactions
Calculate enthalpy changes from calorimetry data using q = mcΔT
